serverOutOfMemory.title: {server} ran out of memory
serverOutOfMemory.text: It reached the server's memory limit and exited. Raise the limit or lower what it uses (players, map, mods).

serverCrashLoop.title: {server} keeps crashing
serverCrashLoop.text: It crashed several times in a row and Pulsar stopped restarting it: it is stopped. Check its console.

serverCrashed.title: {server} crashed
serverCrashed.text: The server exited without being asked to. If it restarts automatically, Pulsar starts it again.

serverNotReady.title: {server} is not ready
serverNotReady.text: It started but did not report ready in time: it may be stuck. Check its console.

backupCopyFailed.title: Remote copy of a backup of {server} failed
backupCopyFailed.text: The backup is on the node, but it could not be uploaded to remote storage.

scheduledTaskFailed.title: Scheduled task “{task}” of {server} failed
scheduledTaskFailed.text: The task could not do its action.

nodeOffline.title: Node {node} is offline
nodeOffline.text: Its game servers keep running, but the panel cannot control them until it connects again.

nodeOnline.title: Node {node} is back online
nodeOnline.text: The panel controls its game servers again.

nodeDiskLow.title: Node {node} is running out of disk space
nodeDiskLow.text: A full drive breaks updates, backups and the game servers themselves. Free some space or delete old backups.

gameUpdateAvailable.title: {server} has a game update
gameUpdateAvailable.text: A newer build of its game is out. Update it from its page when it suits you.
gameUpdateAvailable.installs: A newer build of its game is out. Pulsar installs it by itself, as the server's game updates are set.

gameUpdateInstalled.title: {server} was updated
gameUpdateInstalled.text: Pulsar installed its game's update by itself.

gameUpdateFailed.title: The automatic update of {server} failed
gameUpdateFailed.text: Pulsar could not install its game's update. The server was started again if it was running. Check its console.

templateUpdateAvailable.title: {server} has a newer template
templateUpdateAvailable.text: A newer version of its game's template is in the panel. Move the server to it from its page when it suits you.
templateUpdateAvailable.installs: A newer version of its game's template is in the panel. Pulsar moves the server to it by itself, as the server's updates are set.

templateUpdateInstalled.title: {server} moved to a newer template
templateUpdateInstalled.text: Pulsar installed the server again with the newer version of its game's template, its files and settings kept.

templateUpdateRefused.title: {server} was not moved to a newer template
templateUpdateRefused.text: The newer version of its game's template cannot be applied to the server as it is, so Pulsar left it untouched. Move it by hand from its page once that is fixed.

templateUpdateFailed.title: Moving {server} to a newer template failed
templateUpdateFailed.text: Pulsar could not install the server again with the newer version of its game's template. Check its page: it may need to be installed again.

publicIpCertificateFailed.title: The public IP certificate could not be renewed
publicIpCertificateFailed.text: Let's Encrypt did not issue the panel's certificate. Pulsar tries again on its own, less and less often. Check that the router forwards ports 80 and 8443 to this PC.

publicIpCertificateExpiring.title: The public IP certificate is about to expire
publicIpCertificateExpiring.text: No new one has come yet. Once it expires, visitors from the internet see a security warning until it is renewed.

publicIpCertificateRenewed.title: The public IP certificate was renewed
publicIpCertificateRenewed.text: Let's Encrypt issued the panel's certificate again.

test.title: Test notification from Pulsar
test.text: If you can read this, the channel works.
